scope: Pre-candidate recheck of the UniApp accepted high risk only; no install, lock mutation, runtime resource, or broader upgrade review.

official_sources.fact: Installed plugin metadata declares peerDependencies.vite exactly 5.2.8.
Current npm vue3 dist-tag target (queried as 2026-08-29 alpha) also declares Vite exactly 5.2.8.
DCloud documents separate stable and alpha Vue3/Vite CLI tracks, but does not publish a wider Vite peer range on this page.
Official source repository default branch is uni-app-x; public repository metadata was queried, but its current tree does not expose the npm package path used by the installed plugin.

known_supported: The installed DCloud toolchain officially supports its exact Vite 5.2.8 peer. The newer public vue3 alpha inspected still supports exactly 5.2.8, not Vite 6/7/8.
inference: An arbitrary Vite upgrade would violate the observed DCloud peer contract. No non-disruptive, officially supported upgrade path was found that removes the audit finding while retaining this toolchain family.
decision: This completes the 3.1 preparation-period DCloud/npm support-matrix review. No supported repair was found. Preserve the existing controls and original 2026-10-09 deadline; do not add a risk acceptance or make an audit/vulnerability-zero conclusion. Recheck only if dependencies or the support matrix change before freeze.
uncertainties: npm latest is an older alpha dist-tag while vue3 points at a newer alpha; neither is proof of a production-ready migration.
This review did not run an audit and therefore does not quantify whether Vite 5.2.8 remains affected by a specific advisory.
